metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting a fly and somehow got a kill? Valorant, please explain
metadata.description:
Just me wildly clicking and boom, 1 kill out of nowhere.
Enemy probably uninstalling mid-round.
Valorant’s logic: handing out freebies on accident.
Relatable if your aim’s a mystery but kills still come!

Tap if your best kills were total accidents too!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
